1.name: Pound
1.desc: Hits with a tail or forelegs.

2.name: Karate Chop
2.desc: The foe is attacked with a sharp chop. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

3.name: Double Slap
3.desc: The foe is slapped repeatedly, back and forth, two to five times.

4.name: Comet Punch
4.desc: The foe is hit with a flurry of punches that strike two to five times.

5.name: Mega Punch
5.desc: The foe is slugged by a punch thrown with muscle-packed power.

6.name: Pay Day
6.desc: Numerous coins are hurled at the foe. Money is earned after battle.

7.name: Fire Punch
7.desc: The foe is punched with a fiery fist. It may leave the foe with a burn.

8.name: Ice Punch
8.desc: The foe is punched with an icy fist. It may leave the foe frozen.

9.name: ThunderPunch
9.desc: The foe is punched with an electrified fist. It may leave the foe paralyzed.

10.name: Scratch
10.desc: Hard, pointed, and sharp claws rake the foe.

11.name: Vise Grip
11.desc: Huge, impressive pincers grip and squeeze the foe.

12.name: Guillotine
12.desc: A vicious tearing attack with pincers. The foe will faint if it hits.

13.name: Razor Wind
13.desc: Blades of wind hit the foe on the 2nd turn. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

14.name: Swords Dance
14.desc: A frenetic dance of fighting. It sharply raises the Attack stat.

15.name: Cut
15.desc: A basic slash. It can cut down thin trees and grass.

16.name: Gust
16.desc: Strikes the foe with a gust of wind whipped up by wings.

17.name: Wing Attack
17.desc: The foe is struck with large, imposing wings spread wide.

18.name: Whirlwind
18.desc: Forces the foe to switch out. In the wild, the battle ends.

19.name: Fly
19.desc: A 2-turn move that hits on turn 2. Use it to fly to any known town.

20.name: Bind
20.desc: A long body or tentacles are used to bind the foe for two to five turns.

21.name: Slam
21.desc: The foe is struck with a long tail, vines, etc.

22.name: Vine Whip
22.desc: The foe is struck with slender, whip- like vines.

23.name: Stomp
23.desc: The foe is stomped with a big foot. It may make the foe flinch.

24.name: Double Kick
24.desc: Two legs are used to quickly kick the foe twice in one turn.

25.name: Mega Kick
25.desc: The foe is attacked by a kick fired with muscle-packed power.

26.name: Jump Kick
26.desc: The user jumps up high, then kicks. If it misses, the user hurts itself.

27.name: Rolling Kick
27.desc: A quick kick from a rolling spin. It may make the foe flinch.

28.name: Sand Attack
28.desc: A lot of sand is hurled in the foe’s face, reducing its accuracy.

29.name: Headbutt
29.desc: The user sticks its head out and rams. It may make the foe flinch.

30.name: Horn Attack
30.desc: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed horn to inflict damage.

31.name: Fury Attack
31.desc: The foe is jabbed repeatedly with a horn or beak two to five times.

32.name: Horn Drill
32.desc: The horn is rotated like a drill to ram. The foe will faint if it hits.

33.name: Tackle
33.desc: A physical attack in which the user charges, full body, into the foe.

34.name: Body Slam
34.desc: The user drops its full body on the foe. It may leave the foe paralyzed.

35.name: Wrap
35.desc: A long body or vines are used to wrap the foe for two to five turns.

36.name: Take Down
36.desc: A reckless, full- body charge attack that also hurts the user a little.

37.name: Thrash
37.desc: The user rampages about for two to three turns, then becomes confused.

38.name: Double-Edge
38.desc: A reckless, life- risking tackle that also hurts the user a little.

39.name: Tail Whip
39.desc: The user wags its tail cutely, making the foe lower its Defense stat.

40.name: Poison Sting
40.desc: The foe is stabbed with a toxic barb, etc. It may poison the foe.

41.name: Twineedle
41.desc: The foe is stabbed twice with foreleg stingers. It may poison the foe.

42.name: Pin Missile
42.desc: Sharp pins are shot at the foe and hit two to five times at once.

43.name: Leer
43.desc: The foe is given an intimidating look that lowers its Defense stat.

44.name: Bite
44.desc: The user bites with vicious fangs. It may make the foe flinch.

45.name: Growl
45.desc: The user growls in a cute way, making the foe lower its Attack stat.

46.name: Roar
46.desc: Forces the foe to switch out. In the wild, the battle ends.

47.name: Sing
47.desc: A soothing song in a calming voice lulls the foe into a deep slumber.

48.name: Supersonic
48.desc: The user generates odd sound waves. It may confuse the foe.

49.name: Sonic Boom
49.desc: The foe is hit with a shock wave that always inflicts 20- HP damage.

50.name: Disable
50.desc: For a few turns, it prevents the foe from using the move it last used.

51.name: Acid
51.desc: The foe is sprayed with a harsh, hide- melting acid that may lower Defense.

52.name: Ember
52.desc: The foe is attacked with small flames. The foe may suffer a burn.

53.name: Flamethrower
53.desc: Scorches the foe with intense flames. It may cause a burn.

54.name: Mist
54.desc: The ally party is protected by a mist that prevents stat reductions.

55.name: Water Gun
55.desc: The foe is struck with a lot of water expelled forcibly from the mouth.

56.name: Hydro Pump
56.desc: A high volume of water is blasted at the foe under great pressure.

57.name: Surf
57.desc: A big wave crashes on the foe. Can also be used to cross water.

58.name: Ice Beam
58.desc: The foe is struck with an icy beam. It may leave the foe frozen.

59.name: Blizzard
59.desc: A blizzard strikes the opposing team. It may also freeze them solid.

60.name: Psybeam
60.desc: A peculiar ray is shot at the foe. It may leave the foe confused.

61.name: Bubble Beam
61.desc: A spray of bubbles strikes the foe. It may lower the foe’s Speed stat.

62.name: Aurora Beam
62.desc: A rainbow-colored attack beam. It may lower the foe’s Attack stat.

63.name: Hyper Beam
63.desc: A severely damaging attack. The user must rest next turn.

64.name: Peck
64.desc: The foe is jabbed with a sharply pointed beak or horn.

65.name: Drill Peck
65.desc: A corkscrewing attack with the sharp beak acting as a drill.

66.name: Submission
66.desc: A reckless, full- body throw attack that also hurts the user a little.

67.name: Low Kick
67.desc: A low, tripping kick that inflicts more damage on heavier foes.

68.name: Counter
68.desc: A retaliation move that counters any physical hit with double the damage.

69.name: Seismic Toss
69.desc: A gravity-fed throw that causes damage matching the user’s level.

70.name: Strength
70.desc: The foe is slugged at full power. Can also move boulders.

71.name: Absorb
71.desc: An attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.

72.name: Mega Drain
72.desc: A tough attack that drains half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.

73.name: Leech Seed
73.desc: A seed is planted on the foe to steal some HP for the user on every turn.

74.name: Growth
74.desc: The user’s body is forced to grow, raising the Attack and Sp. Atk stats.

75.name: Razor Leaf
75.desc: The foe is hit with a cutting leaf. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

76.name: Solar Beam
76.desc: A 2-turn move that blasts the foe with absorbed energy on turn 2.

77.name: PoisonPowder
77.desc: A cloud of toxic dust is scattered. It may poison the foe.

78.name: Stun Spore
78.desc: Paralyzing dust is scattered wildly. It may paralyze the foe.

79.name: Sleep Powder
79.desc: A sleep-inducing dust is scattered in high volume around a foe.

80.name: Petal Dance
80.desc: The user attacks with petals for two to three turns, then gets confused.

81.name: String Shot
81.desc: The foe is bound with strings shot from the mouth to reduce its Speed.

82.name: Dragon Rage
82.desc: The foe is hit with a shock wave that always inflicts 40- HP damage.

83.name: Fire Spin
83.desc: The foe is trapped in an intense spiral of fire that rages two to five turns.

84.name: ThunderShock
84.desc: An electric shock attack that may also leave the foe paralyzed.

85.name: Thunderbolt
85.desc: A strong electrical attack. It may leave the foe paralyzed.

86.name: Thunder Wave
86.desc: A weak electric shock that is sure to cause paralysis if it hits.

87.name: Thunder
87.desc: A brutal lightning attack. It may leave the foe paralyzed.

88.name: Rock Throw
88.desc: The foe is attacked with a shower of small, easily thrown rocks.

89.name: Earthquake
89.desc: An earthquake that hits all Pokémon in battle except the user.

90.name: Fissure
90.desc: The foe is dropped into a fissure. The foe faints if it hits.

91.name: Dig
91.desc: Hits on the 2nd turn. Can also be used to exit dungeons.

92.name: Toxic
92.desc: Badly poisons the foe. The poison worsens every turn.

93.name: Confusion
93.desc: A weak telekinetic attack that may also leave the foe confused.

94.name: Psychic
94.desc: A strong telekinetic attack. It may lower the foe’s Sp. Def.

95.name: Hypnosis
95.desc: Hypnotic suggestion is used to make the foe fall into a deep sleep.

96.name: Meditate
96.desc: The user meditates to awaken its power and raise its Attack stat.

97.name: Agility
97.desc: The user relaxes and lightens its body to sharply boost its Speed.

98.name: Quick Attack
98.desc: An almost invisibly fast attack that is certain to strike first.

99.name: Rage
99.desc: An attack that becomes stronger each time the user is hit in battle.

100.name: Teleport
100.desc: Use it to flee from any wild Pokémon. Also warps to the last Poké Center.

101.name: Night Shade
101.desc: An attack with a mirage that inflicts damage matching the user’s level.

102.name: Mimic
102.desc: The user copies the move last used by the foe for the rest of the battle.

103.name: Screech
103.desc: An ear-splitting screech is emitted to sharply reduce the foe’s Defense.

104.name: Double Team
104.desc: The user creates illusory copies to raise its evasiveness.

105.name: Recover
105.desc: A self-healing move that restores HP by up to half of the user’s maximum HP.

106.name: Harden
106.desc: The user stiffens all the muscles in its body to raise its Defense stat.

107.name: Minimize
107.desc: The user shrinks its body to raise its evasiveness.

108.name: Smokescreen
108.desc: An obscuring cloud of smoke or ink reduces the foe’s accuracy.

109.name: Confuse Ray
109.desc: The foe is exposed to a sinister ray that triggers confusion.

110.name: Withdraw
110.desc: The user withdraws its body in its hard shell, raising its Defense stat.

111.name: Defense Curl
111.desc: The user curls up to conceal weak spots and raise its Defense stat.

112.name: Barrier
112.desc: The user creates a sturdy wall that sharply raises its Defense stat.

113.name: Light Screen
113.desc: A wall of light cuts damage from Sp. Atk attacks for five turns.

114.name: Haze
114.desc: Eliminates all stat changes among all Pokémon engaged in battle.

115.name: Reflect
115.desc: A wall of light cuts damage from physical attacks for five turns.

116.name: Focus Energy
116.desc: The user focuses its energy to raise its critical-hit ratio.

117.name: Bide
117.desc: The user endures attacks for two turns, then strikes back double.

118.name: Metronome
118.desc: Waggles a finger and stimulates the brain into using any move at random.

119.name: Mirror Move
119.desc: The user counters the move last used by the foe with the same move.

120.name: Selfdestruct
120.desc: The user blows up to inflict severe damage, even making itself faint.

121.name: Egg Bomb
121.desc: A large egg is hurled with great force at the foe to inflict damage.

122.name: Lick
122.desc: The foe is licked and hit with a long tongue. It may also paralyze.

123.name: Smog
123.desc: The foe is attacked with exhaust gases. It may also poison the foe.

124.name: Sludge
124.desc: Toxic sludge is hurled at the foe. It may poison the target.

125.name: Bone Club
125.desc: The foe is clubbed with a bone held in hand. It may make the foe flinch.

126.name: Fire Blast
126.desc: The foe is hit with an intense flame. It may cause a burn.

127.name: Waterfall
127.desc: A powerful charge attack. It can also be used to climb waterfalls.

128.name: Clamp
128.desc: The foe is squeezed in the user’s shell for two to five turns.

129.name: Swift
129.desc: Star-shaped rays that never miss are fired at all foes in battle.

130.name: Skull Bash
130.desc: The user raises its Defense in the 1st turn, then attacks in the 2nd turn.

131.name: Spike Cannon
131.desc: Sharp spikes are fired at the foe to strike two to five times.

132.name: Constrict
132.desc: The foe is attacked with long tentacles or vines. It may lower Speed.

133.name: Amnesia
133.desc: Forgets about something and sharply raises Sp. Def.

134.name: Kinesis
134.desc: The user distracts the foe by bending a spoon. It may lower accuracy.

135.name: Soft-Boiled
135.desc: Heals the user by up to half its full HP. It can be used to heal an ally.

136.name: Hi Jump Kick
136.desc: A strong jumping knee kick. If it misses, the user is hurt.

137.name: Glare
137.desc: The user intimidates the foe with the design on its belly to cause paralysis.

138.name: Dream Eater
138.desc: Absorbs half the damage it inflicted on a sleeping foe to restore HP.

139.name: Poison Gas
139.desc: The foe is sprayed with a cloud of toxic gas that may poison the foe.

140.name: Barrage
140.desc: Round objects are hurled at the foe to strike two to five times.

141.name: Leech Life
141.desc: An attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.

142.name: Lovely Kiss
142.desc: The user forces a kiss on the foe with a scary face that induces sleep.

143.name: Sky Attack
143.desc: A 2nd-turn attack move with a high critical-hit ratio. The foe may flinch.

144.name: Transform
144.desc: The user transforms into a copy of the foe, including its moves.

145.name: Bubble
145.desc: A spray of bubbles hits the foe. It may lower the foe’s Speed stat.

146.name: Dizzy Punch
146.desc: The foe is hit with a rhythmic punch that may leave it confused.

147.name: Spore
147.desc: The user scatters bursts of fine spores that induce sleep.

148.name: Flash
148.desc: Traps the foe in a whirlpool for 4{F9:D3}5 turns.

149.name: Psywave
149.desc: The foe is attacked with an odd, hot energy wave that varies in intensity.

150.name: Splash
150.desc: The user just flops and splashes around without having any effect.

151.name: Acid Armor
151.desc: The user alters its cells to liquefy itself and sharply raise Defense.

152.name: Crabhammer
152.desc: A large pincer is used to hammer the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

153.name: Explosion
153.desc: The user explodes to inflict terrible damage even while fainting itself.

154.name: Fury Swipes
154.desc: The foe is raked with sharp claws or scythes two to five times.

155.name: Bonemerang
155.desc: The user throws a bone that hits the foe once, then once again on return.

156.name: Rest
156.desc: The user sleeps two turns to fully restore HP and heal status problems.

157.name: Rock Slide
157.desc: Large boulders are hurled at the foe. It may make the foe flinch.

158.name: Hyper Fang
158.desc: The foe is attacked with sharp fangs. It may make the foe flinch.

159.name: Sharpen
159.desc: The user reduces its polygon count to sharpen edges and raise Attack.

160.name: Conversion
160.desc: The user changes its type to match the type of one of its moves.

161.name: Tri Attack
161.desc: A simultaneous 3-beam attack that may paralyze, burn, or freeze the foe.

162.name: Super Fang
162.desc: The user attacks with sharp fangs and halves the foe’s HP.

163.name: Slash
163.desc: The foe is slashed with claws, etc. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

164.name: Substitute
164.desc: The user creates a decoy using one- quarter of its full HP.

165.name: Struggle
165.desc: An attack that is used only if there is no PP. It also hurts the user.

166.name: Sketch
166.desc: This move copies the move last used by the foe, then disappears.

167.name: Triple Kick
167.desc: A 3-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successive hit.

168.name: Thief
168.desc: Takes the foe’s held item if the user isn’t holding one.

169.name: Spider Web
169.desc: Ensnares the foe with sticky string so it doesn’t flee or switch out.

170.name: Mind Reader
170.desc: The user predicts the foe’s action to ensure its next attack hits.

171.name: Nightmare
171.desc: A sleeping foe is shown a nightmare that inflicts some damage every turn.

172.name: Flame Wheel
172.desc: The user makes a fiery charge at the foe. It may cause a burn.

173.name: Snore
173.desc: An attack that can be used only while asleep. It may cause flinching.

174.name: Curse
174.desc: A move that works differently for the Ghost-type and all the other types.

175.name: Flail
175.desc: A desperate attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

176.name: Conversion 2
176.desc: The user changes type to make itself resistant to the last attack it took.

177.name: Aeroblast
177.desc: A vortex of air is shot at the foe. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

178.name: Cotton Spore
178.desc: Cotton-like spores cling to the foe, sharply reducing its Speed stat.

179.name: Reversal
179.desc: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

180.name: Spite
180.desc: A move that cuts 2 to 5 PP from the move last used by the foe.

181.name: Powder Snow
181.desc: The opposing team is hit with powdery snow that may leave them frozen solid.

182.name: Protect
182.desc: Lets the user evade all attacks. May fail if used in succession.

183.name: Mach Punch
183.desc: A punch thrown at blinding speed. It is certain to strike first.

184.name: Scary Face
184.desc: Frightens the foe with a scary face to sharply reduce its Speed.

185.name: Feint Attack
185.desc: The user draws up close to the foe disarmingly, then hits without fail.

186.name: Sweet Kiss
186.desc: The user kisses the foe with sweet cuteness that causes confusion.

187.name: Belly Drum
187.desc: The user maximizes its Attack stat at the cost of half its full HP.

188.name: Sludge Bomb
188.desc: Filthy sludge is hurled at the foe. It may poison the target.

189.name: Mud-Slap
189.desc: Mud is hurled in the foe’s face to inflict damage and lower its accuracy.

190.name: Octazooka
190.desc: Ink is blasted in the foe’s face or eyes to damage and lower accuracy.

191.name: Spikes
191.desc: A trap of spikes is laid around the foe’s party to hurt foes switching in.

192.name: Zap Cannon
192.desc: An electric blast is fired like a cannon to inflict damage and paralyze.

193.name: Foresight
193.desc: Completely negates the foe’s efforts to heighten its ability to evade.

194.name: Destiny Bond
194.desc: If the user faints, the foe delivering the final hit also faints.

195.name: Perish Song
195.desc: Any battler that hears this faints in three turns unless it switches.

196.name: Icy Wind
196.desc: A chilling wind is used to attack. It also lowers the Speed stat.

197.name: Detect
197.desc: Enables the user to evade all attacks. It may fail if used in succession.

198.name: Bone Rush
198.desc: The user strikes the foe with a bone in hand two to five times.

199.name: Lock-On
199.desc: The user locks on to the foe, making the next move sure to hit.

200.name: Outrage
200.desc: The user thrashes about for two to three turns, then becomes confused.

201.name: Sandstorm
201.desc: A 5-turn sandstorm damages all but Rock, Ground, and Steel types.

202.name: Giga Drain
202.desc: A harsh attack that restores HP by half the damage dealt.

203.name: Endure
203.desc: The user endures any hit with 1 HP left. It may fail if used in succession.

204.name: Charm
204.desc: The foe is charmed by the user’s cute appeals, sharply cutting its Attack.

205.name: Rollout
205.desc: A 5-turn rolling attack that becomes stronger each time it hits.

206.name: False Swipe
206.desc: A restrained attack that always leaves the foe with at least 1 HP.

207.name: Swagger
207.desc: A move that makes the foe confused, but also sharply raises its Attack.

208.name: Milk Drink
208.desc: Heals the user by up to half its full HP. It can be used to heal an ally.

209.name: Spark
209.desc: An electrically charged tackle that may also paralyze the foe.

210.name: Fury Cutter
210.desc: An attack that grows stronger on each successive hit.

211.name: Steel Wing
211.desc: Hits with steel wings. It may raise the user’s Defense.

212.name: Mean Look
212.desc: The foe is fixed with a mean look that prevents it from escaping.

213.name: Attract
213.desc: An opposite-gender foe may become infatuated and not attack.

214.name: Sleep Talk
214.desc: While asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

215.name: Heal Bell
215.desc: A soothing bell chimes to heal the status problems of all allies.

216.name: Return
216.desc: The more the user likes its Trainer, the more powerful this is.

217.name: Present
217.desc: The foe is given a booby-trapped gift. It restores HP sometimes, however.

218.name: Frustration
218.desc: The less the user likes its Trainer, the more powerful this is.

219.name: Safeguard
219.desc: Protects the user’s party from status problems for five turns.

220.name: Pain Split
220.desc: Shares HP evenly with the foe.

221.name: Sacred Fire
221.desc: A mystical and powerful fire attack that may inflict a burn.

222.name: Magnitude
222.desc: A ground-shaking attack against all standing Pokémon. Its power varies.

223.name: DynamicPunch
223.desc: The foe is punched with the user’s full power. It confuses the foe if it hits.

224.name: Megahorn
224.desc: A brutal ramming attack delivered with a tough and impressive horn.

225.name: DragonBreath
225.desc: The foe is hit with an incredible blast of breath that may also paralyze.

226.name: Baton Pass
226.desc: The user switches out, passing along any stat changes to the new battler.

227.name: Encore
227.desc: Makes the foe use the move it last used repeatedly for two to six turns.

228.name: Pursuit
228.desc: An attack move that works especially well on a foe that is switching out.

229.name: Rapid Spin
229.desc: Frees the user from traps and hazards. Raises Speed.

230.name: Sweet Scent
230.desc: Allures the foe to reduce evasiveness. It also attracts wild Pokémon.

231.name: Iron Tail
231.desc: A steel-hard tail attack. It may lower the foe’s Defense.

232.name: Metal Claw
232.desc: The foe is attacked with steel claws. It may also raise the user’s Attack.

233.name: Vital Throw
233.desc: Makes the user attack after the foe. In return, it will not miss.

234.name: Morning Sun
234.desc: Restores the user’s HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

235.name: Synthesis
235.desc: Restores the user’s HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

236.name: Moonlight
236.desc: Restores the user’s HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.

237.name: Hidden Power
237.desc: The attack’s type and power vary depending on the user.

238.name: Cross Chop
238.desc: The foe is hit with double chops. It has a high critical-hit ratio.

239.name: Twister
239.desc: A vicious twister attacks the foe. It may make the foe flinch.

240.name: Rain Dance
240.desc: Heavy rain falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves.

241.name: Sunny Day
241.desc: The sun blazes for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

242.name: Crunch
242.desc: The foe is crunched with sharp fangs. It may lower the foe’s Sp. Def.

243.name: Mirror Coat
243.desc: A retaliation move that pays back the foe’s special attack double.

244.name: Psych Up
244.desc: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the foe.

245.name: ExtremeSpeed
245.desc: A blindingly speedy charge attack that always goes before any other.

246.name: AncientPower
246.desc: An ancient power is used to attack. It may also raise all the user’s stats.

247.name: Shadow Ball
247.desc: A shadowy blob is hurled at the foe. May lower its Sp. Def.

248.name: Future Sight
248.desc: Two turns after this move is used, the foe is attacked psychically.

249.name: Rock Smash
249.desc: May lower the foe’s Defense. It can also smash cracked boulders.

250.name: Whirlpool
250.desc: The foe is trapped in a fast, vicious whirlpool for two to five turns.

251.name: Beat Up
251.desc: All party Pokémon join in the attack. The more allies, the more damage.

252.name: Fake Out
252.desc: An attack that hits first and causes flinching. Usable only on 1st turn.

253.name: Uproar
253.desc: The user attacks in an uproar that prevents sleep for two to five turns.

254.name: Stockpile
254.desc: The user charges up power for use later. It can be used three times.

255.name: Spit Up
255.desc: The power built using Stockpile is released at once for attack.

256.name: Swallow
256.desc: The energy it built using Stockpile is absorbed to restore HP.

257.name: Heat Wave
257.desc: The user exhales a heated breath to attack. It may also inflict a burn.

258.name: Hail
258.desc: A five-turn hailstorm damages all Pokémon except Ice-types.

259.name: Torment
259.desc: Enrages the foe so it can’t use the same move in succession.

260.name: Flatter
260.desc: Flattery is used to confuse the foe, but its Sp. Atk also rises.

261.name: Will-O-Wisp
261.desc: A sinister, bluish white flame is shot at the foe to inflict a burn.

262.name: Memento
262.desc: The user faints, but sharply lowers the foe’s Attack and Sp. Atk.

263.name: Facade
263.desc: Power is boosted if the user is burned, poisoned, or paralyzed.

264.name: Focus Punch
264.desc: Attacks last. The user flinches if hit beforehand.

265.name: SmellngSalts
265.desc: Doubly effective on a paralyzed foe, but it also cures the foe’s paralysis.

266.name: Follow Me
266.desc: The user draws attention to itself, making foes attack only the user.

267.name: Nature Power
267.desc: An attack that changes type depending on the user’s location.

268.name: Charge
268.desc: The user charges power to boost the Electric move it uses next.

269.name: Taunt
269.desc: Taunts the foe into a rage so it can only use attack moves.

270.name: Helping Hand
